data.revised_prompt:
Create a 2D game FX sprite sheet in a 2x2 grid, exactly four animation frames, matching the provided guide image only for cell placement, spacing, and centering. Do not draw any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or UI. Solid #FF00FF background everywhere outside the FX. Each frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale, contained within the central 65% of the cell, and nothing may cross cell edges.

Theme: universal special-card trigger effect, deep-sea bioluminescent fantasy, elegant and readable at small card size. It should look like a glowing chrysanthemum flower made of blue-green underwater light beams, NOT an explosion. No fire, smoke, debris, tearing, fragments, cards, icons, or text.

Frame 1: a tiny electric-blue bioluminescent dot at center.
Frame 2: slim blue-green rays pulse open like deep-sea flower petals, subtle and radial.
Frame 3: full luminous abyss flower, chrysanthemum-like, with cyan rim halo, dark-aqua glow edges, and small plankton-like glints.
Frame 4: fading biolume motes and a soft cyan ring, gently dissipating.

Style: clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet, luminous underwater light, crisp readable silhouettes, high contrast against the magenta background, soft glows but contained, no explosion burst shape.
